verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are physical hardware authenticators that run locally on the user's device. There is no hosted service or server-side core product to self-host, so this axis is a category error for this product type. The OpenSK hardware option lets users build and flash firmware from Google's open-source repository, but that is open firmware, not self-hosting, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
